verdict.rationale: Supabase documents first-party self-hosting: it says to "deploy Supabase within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose" for full data control, compliance, or isolated environments. The core project is open source on GitHub, and the CLI runs the entire stack locally or in CI. Community users confirm `supabase start` spins up the stack in Docker, though one team reported difficulty getting local development to work. Missing for 10: detailed evidence on parity between self-hosted and managed features (platform items such as backups, PITR and branching are documented only for hosted plans), and independent hands-on reports of production Docker Compose self-hosting rather than local dev.
